_note: Literature reference values for the uMLIP / DFT validation set. Voltages vs the matching alkali metal.

LiFePO4.source: Padhi, Nanjundaswamy, Goodenough, J. Electrochem. Soc. 144, 1188 (1997): ~3.4-3.5 V plateau vs Li

LiMn2O4.source: Thackeray et al. / Ohzuku et al., J. Electrochem. Soc. 137, 769 (1990): 4 V region (two steps ~4.05/4.15 V) vs Li

NaFePO4_olivine.source: Moreau et al., Chem. Mater. 22, 4126 (2010): ~2.8 V vs Na (as cited by ECS 229 abstract 71201)

Na3Ti2PO43.source: NaTi2(PO4)3 -0.807 V vs Ag/AgCl (aqueous; RSC J. Mater. Chem. A 2019, C9TA08829F) converted: +0.197 V (Ag/AgCl vs SHE), Na+/Na -2.71 V vs SHE

Na2MnFeCN6.source: Song, Wang, Lu, ... Goodenough, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 137, 2658 (2015): dehydrated rhombohedral Na2-dMnFe(CN)6 plateau 3.53 V charge / 3.44 V discharge (mean 3.49 V)

LiFePO4_b_axis.source: Morgan, Van der Ven, Ceder, Electrochem. Solid-State Lett. 7, A30 (2004): GGA NEB, Li hop along [010], dilute vacancy

birnessite_d001_A.source: Shan et al. Nat. Commun. 10, 4975 (2019): pristine 7.19 A; in-situ 7.02-7.33 A
